body: It's not too unlikely to get into this state IMO in case of a large repo and running a delete of a large snapshot or multiple snapshots across many indices. The issue specific to Azure here is that we don't have bulk deletes in Azure and with the new SDK seem to be running all those deletes in parallel. I'll code up a fix for that this morning.

issue.title: Reduce Memory Use of Parallel Azure Blob Deletes

labels.name: :Distributed/Snapshot/Restore
labels.description: Anything directly related to the `_snapshot/*` APIs

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
1. Limit the number of blob deletes to execute in parallel to `100`.
2. Use flat listing when deleting a directory to require fewer listings
in between deletes and keep the code simpler. (and adjust the list request counting to also count flat listings correctly)

closes #71267
